Job Description Are you an experienced Field Service Engineer who enjoys traveling, solving technical challenges, and working on advanced industrial machinery? Train and support operators and maintenance teams. Prepare service reports and provide technical recommendations for improvements. Collaborate with Engineering and Project Management to successfully complete projects. Ensure all work is carried out in accordance with safety and quality standards. Annual bonus scheme. 27 vacation days plus 13 additional ADV (reduction of working hours) days. Excellent pension scheme. Company laptop, mobile phone, and professional tools. Functie-eisen We are looking for a hands-on engineer with a passion for technology and international travel. Knowledge of mechanical, electrical, pneumatic, and preferably PLC-controlled systems. Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills. Good communication skills in English (Dutch is an advantage). A willingness to travel internationally on a regular basis. A valid driver's license (Category B). A customer-focused and independent working attitude.
